## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and the adapter or isolation boundary affected.

## Verification

- [ ] Control-plane tests pass.
- [ ] Runtime tests pass.
- [ ] Lint and strict type checks pass.
- [ ] New behavior has tests or a documented reason why it cannot be tested here.
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, or tenant data are included.
- [ ] Security assumptions and migration impact are documented.

## Isolation changes

If this changes Bubblewrap arguments, permissions, mounts, networking, UID handling,
or backend selection, include the probe evidence and outer-container requirements.
